title: Freestanding Swing Arm Towel Valet 49-Inch Solid Brass | Golden Yellow | Assorted Free Standing Accessories | Allied Brass
short_title: Freestanding 4 Pivoting Swing Arm Towel Valet 49-Inch, Golden Yellow
description:
Keep bath towels within reach without drilling into walls—this freestanding 4 pivoting swing arm towel valet creates instant hanging space right where you need it in Golden Yellow, which radiates warm, sunny energy that brightens any bathroom with cheerful, optimistic personality.

Highlights:
- Golden Yellow transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Enjoy steady, tip-resistant placement thanks to a large weighted base
- Count on enduring materials with solid brass construction designed to resist rust and corrosion
- Coordinate your bathroom look with the Assorted Free Standing Accessories collection and multiple designer finish options

Specs & Installation:
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 12 in. x 49 in. x 10.5 in.
- Shipping weight: 17 lbs
- Assembly: some assembly required
- Warranty: limited lifetime warranty
- Made in the USA
